clue.text: Film director's family felt the heat at first

indicators.note: says the heat-felt word comes before the family word

parts.note: food that has felt the heat of the pan has been fried
kin means family, relatives

explanation.surface: A film-maker's relatives were the first to suffer under pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at first' puts FRIED before KIN. The 's after 'director' reads as 'is'. William Friedkin directed The Exorcist.
explanation.definitionFit: William Friedkin was the American director of The French Connection and The Exorcist.

clue.text: Poorly insured son is going bankrupt

indicators.note: poorly means badly, so the remaining letters are put together badly, in a new order
the son is going, so his letter leaves the word

explanation.surface: An under-insured family member is facing financial ruin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'son is going' takes S out of INSURED, leaving INURED, and 'Poorly' rearranges that.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is ruined has lost all their money, just as a bankrupt person has.

clue.text: New exotic pen in special case

indicators.note: new signals that the letters of the following words are made into something new

explanation.surface: A fancy new fountain pen is kept in a special presentation case.
explanation.definitionFit: An exception is an instance that does not follow the rule, a case treated specially.

clue.text: They swim off across river

indicators.note: the killing word lies across the river letter, which goes inside it

parts.note: to off someone is slang for to kill them
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: People set off swimming across a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Krill are tiny shrimp-like crustaceans that swim in vast swarms in the ocean.

clue.text: Most impressive split headline is French

parts.note: the word headline is split into head and line: head is NOB (slang) and line gives L
est is French for is

explanation.surface: A newspaper's two-part headline is the best one, and it's in French.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'headline' into 'head' and 'line': NOB is slang for the head, and L is the abbreviation for line.
explanation.definitionFit: Noblest means grandest or most stately, the most impressive of all.

clue.text: Nutcases operated in Langley?

indicators.note: the operated word goes in the agency letters

parts.note: Langley, Virginia is the headquarters of the CIA
ran means operated, as a business is run

explanation.surface: Lunatics have been running things at the CIA's headquarters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nutcases' looks like slang for madmen; read it literally as the cases holding nuts, the slang for heads.
explanation.definitionFit: Crania are skulls, the bony cases holding the brain, and nut is slang for the head.

clue.text: Italian composer has a revolutionary massage in India

parts.note: Che Guevara is the crossword's favourite revolutionary
to rub is to massage
I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A composer from Italy gets a revolutionary massage while in India.
explanation.definitionFit: Luigi Cherubini was an Italian composer of operas and sacred music, working largely in Paris.

clue.text: Everyone around the Bluegrass state is radical

indicators.note: the everyone word goes around the state's code

parts.note: all means everyone
Kentucky, nicknamed the Bluegrass State, has the postal code KY

explanation.surface: Everybody in Kentucky is said to be politically extreme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'radical' reads as political extremism; here it is the chemistry sense, a group of atoms acting as a unit.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry an alkyl is a radical, a group of atoms such as methyl derived from an alkane.

clue.text: Dinner set occasionally given to act as compensation

indicators.note: the act word is given to, added after, the first part
occasionally means now and then, so only every other letter is used

parts.note: the even letters of dinner set, read every other one, are I, N, R, E
a turn is an act on stage, as in a variety turn

explanation.surface: A dinner service is now and then given away to make up for something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'occasionally' takes the even letters of 'Dinner set': I, N, R, E.
explanation.definitionFit: Something given in return is given in exchange, as recompense for what was received.

clue.text: Wave after round trip

indicators.note: the wave word goes after the round word

parts.note: a circuit is a round, as a lap of a course
a breaker is a large wave breaking on the shore

explanation.surface: A wave comes in after a round trip at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round trip' looks like one phrase; 'trip' is the definition, the switch that trips.
explanation.definitionFit: A circuit breaker is an electrical switch that cuts the current, often called a trip switch.

clue.text: Writer attached to China as correspondent

indicators.note: the writer word has the china word attached after it

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument
china means mate, from Cockney rhyming slang china plate

explanation.surface: A writer who is fond of China works as its foreign correspondent.
explanation.walkthrough: In Cockney rhyming slang 'china plate' means mate, so a china is a pal.
explanation.definitionFit: A pen pal is someone you exchange letters with, a regular correspondent.

clue.text: English characteristic that the elitists might not like?

definitions.text: that the elitists might not like?

parts.note: a quality is a characteristic or trait

explanation.surface: A trait of the English that snobs are said to dislike.
explanation.definitionFit: Elitists believe some people are superior to others, so they would oppose the principle of everyone being equal.

clue.text: Some fritter billions, 8 for Da Ponte's works?

indicators.note: 8 is 8-down, IN RETURN, which here means read back to front
only some of the letters of fritter billions are used, a run inside them

parts.note: the run of letters ITTERBIL sits inside fritter billions

explanation.surface: Spending billions recklessly is what some people do instead of making their own works.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' finds ITTERBIL inside 'fritter billions'; '8' borrows the answer to 8-down, in return, as the signal to read those letters backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Lorenzo Da Ponte wrote the texts of Mozart's operas Figaro, Don Giovanni and Così fan tutte.

clue.text: People who sell Dior's latest and earliest fashions

parts.note: the latest, last, letter of Dior is R

indicators.note: fashions as a verb means shapes, so the letters are shaped anew

explanation.surface: Shopkeepers stock both Dior's newest and oldest designs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fashions' looks like a noun about clothes but works as a verb, reshaping EARLIEST.
explanation.definitionFit: Retailers are traders who sell goods directly to the public in shops.

clue.text: Unelected Head of State visits a European port

indicators.note: the monarch's letters go inside, visiting, the other letters

parts.note: a monarch is an unelected head of state; CR is Carolus Rex, King Charles

explanation.surface: A king or queen makes a state visit to a port in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Acre is an ancient harbour city in northern Israel, famous from the Crusades.

clue.text: American carved a large breast in white stone

indicators.note: carved means cut into a new shape, so these letters are reshaped

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: An American sculptor carved a big bosom in white marble.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabaster is a soft white translucent mineral, often carved into ornaments and statues.

clue.text: Jack the Ripper copycat taking pee? He sprays all over the place

definitions.text: He sprays all over the place

indicators.note: the copycat word takes the letter into itself

parts.note: a slasher is a knife-wielding attacker like the Ripper
pee is the spoken name of the letter P

explanation.surface: A copycat of Jack the Ripper relieves himself and splashes everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pee' is just the name of the letter P, not the bodily function the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: A splasher is someone who scatters liquid about, spraying it messily everywhere.

clue.text: Start working after drinking a short

indicators.note: the working word drinks in, contains, the short

parts.note: on means working, as a machine is on
a peg is a short measure of spirits; cut short it gives PE

explanation.surface: Someone gets going on the job only after downing a small spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: A peg is a measure of spirits, a short drink; 'short' also clips its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To open is to begin, as a play opens or a speaker opens a meeting.

clue.text: Island king into heavy metal and current pop

indicators.note: the king letter goes into the metal

parts.note: tin is a metal
R is Rex, Latin for king
I is the physics symbol for electric current
pop is an informal word for a father, a dad

explanation.surface: A king on an island is into heavy metal music, while the current one prefers pop.
explanation.definitionFit: Trinidad is the larger island of Trinidad and Tobago in the southern Caribbean.

clue.text: Loosely, it means 10s?

definitions.note: 10-across is PEN PAL; read literally, pals in a pen, a prison

indicators.note: loosely means not held firmly, so the letters are let go and rearranged

explanation.surface: A vague hint that the word means correspondents.
explanation.walkthrough: Pen pals, read loosely, are pals in a pen, slang for a prison, so prisoners.
explanation.definitionFit: Inmates share a prison, the pen, so they are literally the pals of the pen.

clue.text: Doctor's striking costume

parts.note: to doctor is to rig or falsify; the 's reads as is, the verb form
workers who are striking are out

explanation.surface: A doctor is wearing an eye-catching outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'striking' suggests eye-catching; it means on strike, out.
explanation.definitionFit: A rig-out is an informal British word for an outfit or set of clothes.

clue.text: Circulated document provided one better political stance

indicators.note: circulated means turned round, so the whole sequence is read backwards

parts.note: MS is manuscript, a document
if means provided, as in provided that
I is the Roman numeral one
to cap is to better or outdo

explanation.surface: A circulated paper is supposed to give a better political position.
explanation.definitionFit: Pacifism is the principled opposition to war and violence as a means of settling disputes.

clue.text: Home Office supports regular uprising

indicators.note: in a down clue the loo sits below the soldier and holds it up
in a down clue uprising means the word reads upwards

parts.note: a GI is a regular soldier in the US army
offices is an old euphemism for a lavatory, the loo

explanation.surface: The Home Office backs a routine rebellion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uprising' turns GI into IG, and 'supports' puts LOO beneath it. 'Home Office' looks like the government department; 'Home' defines and 'Office' is the loo.
explanation.definitionFit: An igloo is the dome-shaped snow house built as a dwelling by Inuit people.

clue.text: One rarely scores work at the start of a romance

indicators.note: the work word goes at the start of the rest

parts.note: to go is to work, as a machine goes
to romance is to tell fanciful tales, a lie

explanation.surface: Someone works hard at the start of an affair but seldom gets lucky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scores' hints at romantic success; it means scoring a goal.
explanation.definitionFit: A goalkeeper's job is to stop goals, and they very seldom score one themselves.

clue.text: Despair for one pair of soldiers

parts.note: the first of the pair of soldiers is a GI, an American soldier
the second is an ANT, as soldier ants are a caste of ant

explanation.surface: Two soldiers sink into deep despair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pair of soldiers' asks for two soldiers in a row: GI then ANT. Giant Despair is the ogre of Doubting Castle in Bunyan's The Pilgrim's Progress.
explanation.definitionFit: In Bunyan's allegory the giant who imprisons Christian and Hopeful is named Despair.

clue.text: Author in Hanoi's Premier Hotel worked out pi

indicators.note: worked out means solved or reworked, so these letters are rearranged
premier means first, so only the first letter of Hanoi's is used

parts.note: the first letter of Hanoi is H

explanation.surface: A writer staying at Hanoi's best hotel calculated the value of pi.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pi' looks like the mathematical constant; it is the crossword abbreviation for pious.
explanation.definitionFit: Pi is short for pious, and a holier-than-thou person is sanctimoniously self-righteous.

clue.text: Bears seen in British castles

parts.note: in chess the rook is also called the castle

explanation.surface: Bears have been spotted in British castles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bears' looks like the animals; it is the verb, puts up with.
explanation.definitionFit: To brook something is to tolerate it, so brooks means bears or endures.

clue.text: Planet virtually consumed in swamp

indicators.note: virtually means almost, so the planet loses its final letter

parts.note: Saturn is a planet
ate means consumed

explanation.surface: A planet was nearly swallowed up in a marsh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'virtually' cuts SATURN to SATUR. 'swamp' looks like a noun; it is the verb, to flood.
explanation.definitionFit: To swamp is to drench or flood completely, which is what saturate means.
